# crosswork_l2vpn_etag_sets (Resource)

This resource can manage an L2VPN Ethernet tag set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_l2vpn_etag_sets" "example" {
  name = "cwtest-l2-etags"
  etag = [5]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Etag set. Any ASCII character except `%`, `?` and `#`.

### Optional

- `etag` (Set of Number) Ethernet tags of the set, 0 to 4294967295
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_l2vpn_etag_sets.example "<name>"
```
